question: What action should the UE take if a cell is indicated as 'barred' for cell selection/reselection? [3GPP Release 17]
options: Exclude the barred cell as a candidate for cell selection/reselection for 300 seconds
Select another cell on the same frequency if the selection criteria are fulfilled
Select the same cell in normal coverage if able to acquire necessary information
Select the same cell in enhanced coverage if able to acquire necessary information
All of the above
correct_answer: All of the above

Rx hopping
Both Tx and Rx hopping
